title: Homological Certificate Topologies on Conflict-Clause Poset Lattices: A Lean 4–Verified Step-Counting Framework for Sub-Exponential 3-SAT Cost Bounds (ConflictClauseLattice v1.1.1)

creators.name: Frohman, Benjamin Stanley
creators.affiliation: Abstract AI Research Syndicate & Formal Methods Engineering Group

description: Complete LaTeX manuscript (main.pdf), interactive 3D WebGL Hasse diagram and homological explorer (conflict_clause_lattice.html), and machine-checked Lean 4 package (ConflictClauseLattice, v4.30.0-rc1 + Mathlib v4.30.0-rc1) containing 69 verified theorems with 0 sorry and 0 nonstandard axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). Formalizes the graded conflict-clause poset L_3 (27 conflict clauses, 54 edges), cellular boundary complex d_{k-1} o d_k = 0, exact #3-SAT unobstructed atom bijection, pure functional step-counting monad (CountM := StateM CountingState) with Monad Reduction (simp [Bind.bind, StateT.bind]), State Injection (injection), Presburger arithmetic bounds (omega), and real-valued sub-exponential complexity bounds using Mathlib's Real.log and Real.rpow (block_homological_traversal_real_log_bound, simulateBlockHomologicalTraversal_at_logBlockSize_bound, subExponential_rpow_lt_two_pow, simulateLatticeTraversal_exceeds_subExponential_bound, and denominator_divergence). Includes Lake kernel build certificate, Titan-Audit Ed25519 attestation, and SealGuard SHA-256 Merkle provenance manifest.
